thread:
Maya: Quick capture from today's FinPlate onboarding call — logging asks so CS + Product can triage. Short bullet list: 1) ephemeral sandbox that mirrors prod (with automated redaction), 2) detailed per-customer cost exports (hourly + per-route + model, >=90d), 3) embeddings latency spikes on large batch uploads.
Jamal: paste the exact wording from them if you have it, helps with intake.
Maya: verbatim snippets from their notes/screenshots:
- "Need a sandbox env that reproduces our prod limits but strips PII automatically."
- "Cost UI doesn't let us slice by route+model historically, need hourly granularity and CSV export."
- "Embedding jobs (50k rows) sometimes see >800ms per request, causing our pipeline retries."
Eli: embeddings question — is this isolated to text-embedding-compact-v2 or across multiple models? any trace ids?
Maya: they used text-embedding-compact-v2 with a custom batching script. I asked for traces and a sample payload; will DM artifacts to the thread.
Sophia: sandbox + redaction is recurring. Can we make a CS-facing quickstart (one-click setup) using our internal sandbox checklist? Would lower friction a lot.
Jamal: suggest we score this by: impact (customer ARR + renewal window) x frequency x dev effort. FYI FinPlate is mid-market, renewal in ~6mo so medium-high impact.
Eli: for immediate mitigation on embeddings: recommend reducing batch size by ~30% and enable KV caching for duplicate items. I can assemble a short diagnostic script + config snippets.
Maya: that's perfect — they prefer config changes over code work, so we'll offer the config adjustments first.
Sophia: I'll draft a 1-pager enablement playbook: steps for ephemeral sandbox + redaction checklist + how to run Eli's diagnostic.
Jamal: rough effort estimates? Eli: quick mitigation doc (low), sandbox automation for CS (med), full billing export UI (high).
Eli: estimates: triage doc + diagnostic script = ~2 dev-days. CS automation for ephemeral sandbox = ~1 sprint (about 3 dev-days + infra). Billing export UI requires discovery; ballpark 2-3 sprints.
Maya: action items — Eli: diagnostic + config doc (ETA this Fri). Sophia: enablement playbook (ETA Mon). Maya: collect traces + confirm FinPlate ok with sandbox testing (today). Jamal: add prioritization score in intake board.
ops-bot: Reminder to complete the CS intake form for product requests: https://redwood.internal/cs-intake — helps speed triage and ensures critical fields (customer size, renewal window).
Jamal: added a preliminary priority on the intake board. Maya, drop the traces and sample payload in this thread when you have them.
Maya: will do. If no one opts in for a quick triage huddle tomorrow, I'll move this into CS backlog and flag for the next product planning sync. :thumbsup:
